copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会执行把 Discord 机器人加为聊天渠道的流程:复制并注册 Discord 适配器、安装依赖、构建并跑测试,再引导你创建机器人、填 Bot Token、邀请进服务器并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提出要把 Discord 加为聊天渠道,或在设置流程中走到新增渠道这一步时触发;机器人未建好或 Token 校验失败时会暂停并让你处理。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接上 Discord 机器人。
say.note: 开始执行添加 Discord 渠道的流程。

say.text: 我要新增 Discord 聊天渠道,开始设置吧。
say.note: 会复制适配器,并给出下一步操作指引。

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token,请继续配置。
say.note: 校验并写入 Token,完成设置后提示重启。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs the Discord channel integration: copies and registers the Discord adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests; then walks you through creating the bot, entering the token, inviting it to a server, and restarting.
howto.when_en: It starts when you ask to add Discord as a chat channel, for example during setup or by requesting add-discord; it pauses if the bot isn't created or the token fails validation.

say_en.text: Please add Discord as a chat channel for this project.
I want to set up a Discord bot channel.
say_en.note: Walks through adapter install and Discord portal setup.

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token — continue setup.
say_en.note: Validates the token, saves config, then restarts.
